study: retrospective follow-up designed after observing original undercoverage; not external holdout
maturity_rule: prior origin_date < current origin_date AND target_date < current origin_date
fallback: first qualifying pool; if none leave unchanged (including first origin)
window: all matured prior original online forecasts; never recalibrated residuals
tuning: one fixed rule; no search or adjustment after observing calibrated results
bootstrap: 2000 paired whole-origin resamples, seed 42; descriptive dependence caveat
